item.title: Suncraft
item.description:
Title: Suncraft
Genre: Adventure , Casual , Simulation
Developer: Spicy Tuna Games
Publisher: Spicy Tuna Games
Release Date: Jul 28, 2026




About This Game

Suncraft is a cozy pixel art adventure focused on growth and restoration. Step into a peaceful world where every tool you craft brings a new spark of life to the village. Settle into a relaxing rhythm of progress as you watch the village return to the glory it once had.

Do you want to enjoy the atmosphere of Suncraft? Wishlist Suncraft today to be notified at launch!

CORE GAMEPLAY

  • Explore and Gather

    Journey through the land and collect materials while unlocking new biomes.

  • Craft and Rebuild

    Build workstations, construct machines, and craft components piece by piece to repair the village and revive the land.

  • Upgrade and Automate

    Unlock new gear, master powerful skills, and recruit loyal companions to help you along the way.

QUESTS AND MYSTERIES

  • Complete objectives for villagers to uncover the story of the village.

item.title: Bonehold
item.description:
Title: Bonehold
Genre: Action , Adventure , Indie , RPG
Developer: Pixel Jackal , SaikingS
Publisher: Pixel Jackal
Franchise: Bonehold
Release Date: Jul 28, 2026




About This Game

Bonehold is a 3D roguelike dungeon crawler with ARPG and hack-and-slash elements, blending fast-paced combat with strategic exploration.

Choose from 7 unique character classes , including the Knight , Barbarian , Scorcher , Spellblade, and more, each offering distinct playstyles and abilities.

Venture into Bonehold’s ancient fortress, battling hordes of skeletons, ghosts, and magical abominations.

Discover procedurally generated treasure s like weapons, spells, and armor, allowing endless possibilities for custom builds.

The game’s striking art style combines hand-painted textures with pixel art , creating a visually stunning and immersive world.

Only the brave and skilled will conquer Bonehold’s depths, are you ready?

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: 7
    • Processor: AMD Phenom(tm) 8450 Triple-Core Processor (3 CPUs), ~2.1GHz or Intel Core 2 Duo E8400 @ 3.0 GHz
    • Memory: 4 MB RAM
    • Graphics: Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce GTX 470 (1Gb VRAM) / ATI Radeon TM HD 6870 (1Gb VRAM)
    • Storage: 1 MB available space
    • Sound Card: DirectX 11 sound device
    Recommended:
    • OS: 10
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400, 4.0 GHz
    • Memory: 8 MB RAM
    • Graphics: Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970
    • Storage: 2 MB available space
    • Sound Card: DirectX 11 sound device

item.title: Shards of Order
item.description:
Title: Shards of Order
Genre: Adventure , Indie , RPG , Strategy
Developer: Fardust
Publisher: Awaken Realms
Franchise: Awaken Realms
Release Date: Jul 28, 2026




About This Game





Shards of Order is a dark fantasy RPG that throws out the rulebook for deckbuilding & card-based combat. There are no turns and no mana points. Every enemy acts on a visible countdown, and every card you play winds those counters down, shifting the whole flow of the fight. Time is your most valuable resource. Misjudge, and your team is sure to crumble.

Master the art of shared deckbuilding; there are three heroes, but only one set of cards. Every card you add affects the drawing odds. Will you build around one main hero and stack the deck in their favor, or spread the strength across the whole party and keep everyone in the fight?




Reality is coming apart. The ancient Laws that once held life, death, and time in place have been stolen or shattered. What’s left is a world where identity fractures and the dead refuse to stay buried. A handful of survivors set out to put it back together, one broken Law at a time. You’re their leader, and restoring Order is up to you – If you find it worth saving.




Play as three distinct characters, each with multiple playstyles, their own skill trees, and a personal arc. This is a full RPG underneath the cards: level up, customize equipment, make dialogue choices, and pass skill checks. Weapons and armor aren't just stat sticks. They define each hero's playstyle and can even inject unique cards straight into your shared deck, so every gear decision is also a deckbuilding decision. Layer the right gear across all three and your party starts working like one organism.





The time counter system is the heart of combat in Shards of Order. Each enemy shows exactly when it will act next, and each card you play pushes those moments closer or further away. You're not reacting turn by turn, but rather managing a clock for your entire party at once. One mistimed card can unravel the whole fight, so every move is a calculation. Three unique regions and a roster of handcrafted boss fights will push your time mastery to the limit.




As you scavenge a dying world, you recover the lost Laws that once governed it. But restoration comes at a cost. Each Law you bring back draws the eye of the all-seeing God a little closer. In your darkest moments, they will offer a helping hand, and you're free to take it. But be warned: they are known for their mischief…

Now, embark on this journey through ruin, where every decision leaves a scar, and every scar becomes part of your story.

There is no more Order. Only what you are strong enough to bring back.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

The game contains stylized extreme violence and gore, including dismemberment, hanging entrails, blood, and enemies being destroyed into bloody pulp. The violence is exaggerated and non-realistic in presentation, with no sexual content, sexual assault, substance abuse, or self-harm themes.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
    • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    • Graphics: GTX 750 / Radeon HD 7770
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 4 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
    • Processor: Quad-core 3.0 GHz
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: GTX 1060
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 4 GB available space

item.title: Halo: Campaign Evolved
item.description:
Title: Halo: Campaign Evolved
Genre: Action , Adventure
Developer: Halo Studios
Publisher: Xbox Game Studios
Franchise: Halo
Release Date: Jul 28, 2026




About This Game

EXPERIENCE WHERE THE LEGEND BEGINS

Halo: Campaign Evolved is a faithful yet modernized remake of Halo: Combat Evolved’s campaign. Experience the original story rebuilt with high-definition visuals, updated cinematics, refined controls, plus a brand-new three-mission adventure featuring the Master Chief and Sgt. Johnson. A broader arsenal of weapons, vehicles, enemies, and gameplay-modifying “Skulls” – optional modifiers that change combat in fun and challenging ways – add fresh tactics and endless replayability.

Play it your way: solo or up to 4-player online co-op with full crossplay and cross-progression support. Whether you’re discovering Halo for the first time or returning to the ring after 25 years, Halo: Campaign Evolved delivers an adventure that feels both timeless and brand new.

DISCOVER THE RINGWORLD:

After crash landing on a mysterious ringworld known as Halo, the Master Chief is tasked with helping the remaining humans survive against overwhelming Covenant forces. Alongside his AI companion Cortana, he uncovers Halo’s dark secrets and fights to avert the annihilation of all life in the galaxy.

THE COMPLETE CAMPAIGN, REBUILT:

Battle through the original missions, remade with high-def visuals, updated cinematics, and refined level design.

CINEMATICS AND AUDIO OVERHAULED:

All-new visuals and animations, plus a remastered soundtrack and fully rebuilt sound design for deeper immersion.

COMBAT AND WEAPONS EXPANDED:

Classic Halo combat feels sharper than ever, now with 9 additional iconic weapons from across the series to add to your arsenal.

THREE NEW MISSIONS:

Play as the Master Chief alongside Sgt. Johnson in Operation: Meteorite, a standalone combat operation featuring new environments, gameplay, and enemies.

PLAY SOLO OR WITH FRIENDS:

Experience the complete campaign your way, solo or in 4-player online co-op, complete with crossplay and shared progression across console and PC.

DRIVE, HIJACK, WREAK HAVOC:

Halo’s iconic vehicles return with more ways to create unforgettable chaos. For the first time in Halo: CE, hijack enemy vehicles and pilot a fully drivable Wraith tank.

ENDLESS REPLAYABILITY:

Remix every mission with optional “Skull” modifiers that add variety and challenge with randomized weapons, enemies, and environments.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work:
Blood and Gore, Intense Violence, Strong Language



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 11
    • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or Intel Core i7-10700K
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 6600, Intel Arc A580 or Nvidia Ge-Force RTX 2060 Super
    • Storage: 100 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 11
    • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 7700 or Intel Core i7-12700K
    • Memory: 32 GB RAM
    • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 9070 or Nvidia 3080 Ti
    • Storage: 100 GB available space

item.title: Sir, We Have an Orc Problem
item.description:
Title: Sir, We Have an Orc Problem
Genre: Indie , Simulation , Strategy
Developer: Mumpitz Games
Publisher: Mumpitz Games
Release Date: Jul 28, 2026




About This Game

Sir, We Have an Orc Problem is a short tower defense game with incremental-style meta-progression.

A bazillion orcs

Defend your base against an overwhelming number of orcs. They're coming with tens of thousands of troops to overrun you. Greet them with even more bullets, bombs and lasers!

Massive upgrade tree

Use resources earned from every run, won or lost, to unlock and upgrade powerful turrets. Every upgrade brings you closer to defeating the horde.

Active abilities

Launch strafing runs, orbital lasers and even nukes to slaughter masses of orcs and survive critical situations.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Killed enemies leave blood and corpses lying around



System Requirements

Windows

Linux
